description: Close a tunnel previously opened with up_tunnel, by its tunnel_id. By default only the up_tunnel pin is released: if live connection pools still use the tunnel it stays open and their keys are returned in remaining_holders. With force=true the holder pools are drained and the tunnel is closed unconditionally (the next query recreates them).

force.description: Drain holder pools and close the tunnel unconditionally

name: down_tunnel
